Our craft

Slow hands. Honest ingredients.

Baking is not rushed here. It is kneaded, rested, piped and finished by people who care how the last bite tastes.

  • Made by hand

    Doughs are kneaded and creams are piped by hand, never hurried off a line.

  • Quality ingredients

    Real chocolate, fresh cream and nuts we would happily eat straight from the bowl.

  • Finished with detail

    Every cake is finished one at a time, checked, and only then boxed for you.

Good to know

Questions, answered

How do I place an order?+

Message us on WhatsApp at +91 63037 01543 or call us on the same number. Tell us what you are celebrating and we will help you pick the right cake, box or table.

Can I customise a cake?+

Yes. Custom celebration cakes are what we do best, for birthdays, anniversaries and milestones. Share your idea on WhatsApp and we will craft it with you, flavours, size and finish included.

Do you make gift hampers?+

We do. Choose a box, fill it with cakes, kunafa, cookies and chocolates, add a personal note, and we will finish it with ribbon and wrapping, ready to gift.

Can you handle corporate or bulk gifting?+

Yes. For corporate and bulk gifting, call us on +91 63037 01543 and we will plan it together, from box size to the treats inside.

Do you style grazing tables for events?+

We do. Our dessert grazing tables are styled for weddings, celebrations and gatherings of all sizes. Message us on WhatsApp to plan your event.

Where can I find you?+

We are at Ahuja Estate, Nampally, Hyderabad. Drop by, or reach us any time on WhatsApp at +91 63037 01543.

Have something sweet in mind?

From a single cake to a full grazing table, tell us what you are planning and we will make it delicious.
